_note: Plain-English explanations for each kind of information a listing can show. Used by app/explain.py to write each exposure's summary and details. Edit the wording here, not in code. Never say a company 'leaked' anything.

address.label: Home address
address.why: It tells anyone where you live, and past addresses map out where you've lived before.
misuse: Find your home or show up there
Send mail or packages in your name, or redirect your mail
Answer "confirm your address" questions when opening credit in your name
address.protect: Freeze your credit with Equifax, Experian and TransUnion (it's free), so no one can open accounts in your name.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.why: Your phone number is tied to your accounts and often receives your login codes.
misuse: Spam calls and scam texts that use your name to look real
SIM-swap attacks that move your number to their phone and catch your login codes
Look you up on other people-search sites
phone.protect: Ask your carrier for a port-out PIN or SIM lock, and use an authenticator app instead of text-message codes.

email.label: Email address
email.why: Your email address is the username for most of your accounts.
misuse: Phishing emails that look like they come from services you use
Trying passwords from old breaches against your accounts
Finding your other accounts and profiles
email.protect: Turn on two-step login for your email, and give it a password you don't use anywhere else.

relatives.label: Relatives and associates
relatives.why: Family names are the answers to common security questions, and they make scams believable.
misuse: Answer security questions like your mother's maiden name
"Family emergency" scams that pretend to be someone you know
Find and target the people close to you
relatives.protect: Stop using real family names as security answers; use random answers saved in a password manager.

age.label: Age
age.why: Your age narrows down your birth year, which many identity checks ask for.
misuse: Guess your date of birth for identity checks
Target you with scams aimed at your age group
age.protect: Don't use your birth year or date in passwords or PINs.

birthdate.label: Date of birth
birthdate.why: Banks, phone carriers and government services use your date of birth to confirm it's you.
misuse: Pass identity checks to open accounts or credit in your name
Reset passwords on accounts that ask for your birth date
birthdate.protect: Freeze your credit, and add a verbal password to your bank and phone accounts.

employer.label: Employer
employer.why: Where you work makes phishing look official, and tells people where to find you during the day.
misuse: Fake emails from your "boss" or IT team (spear phishing)
Find you at work
employer.protect: Be wary of urgent work requests that come from outside your company's email.

name.label: Full name
name.why: Your name is the key that links this listing to everything else about you online.
misuse: Search other sites to build a fuller profile of you
Link this listing to your social media accounts
name.protect: Request removal here, so this page stops connecting your name to your details.
